meta.name: to-prd
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a PRD and publish it to the project issue tracker — no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把讨论内容整理成产品需求文档并发布到项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你们在讨论中确定了需求，需要快速产出PRD并同步到项目
copy.tagline_en: Turn your conversation into a PRD and publish it to the project tracker
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn discussion outcomes into a structured PRD and share it with the team

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据当前对话和代码库理解，自动生成一份产品需求文档（PRD），并发布到项目的 issue 跟踪器中。
howto.when: 当用户与 Claude 讨论完一个功能需求，希望将讨论结果整理成正式 PRD 时触发。

say.text: 把我们刚才讨论的登录功能整理成 PRD 并发布。
say.note: Claude 会生成 PRD 并发布到 issue 跟踪器。

say.text: 基于对话内容生成 PRD，发布到项目。
say.note: Claude 会合成 PRD 并发布。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically generate a Product Requirements Document (PRD) based on the current conversation and codebase understanding, then publish it to the project's issue tracker.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user has discussed a feature requirement with Claude and wants to formalize the discussion into a PRD.

say_en.text: Turn our discussion about the login feature into a PRD and publish it.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the PRD and publish it to the issue tracker.

say_en.text: Generate a PRD from our conversation and publish it to the project.
say_en.note: Claude will synthesize the PRD and publish it.
